title: The Wandering Edit
description:
## Fix the Bug: The Wandering Edit

The list renders fine. The reverse button reorders the array. But edits to the input fields don't follow their item — they stay glued to the **position** they were typed in.

### Symptoms
- Edit the Apple input to "Apple Pie"
- Click **Reverse**
- The text "Apple Pie" now appears on **Cherry** (the new top row), not on the Apple input

### Your Task
Make each input stay with its item after a reorder.

> **Think about it:** React decides whether to reuse or recreate a child by its **`key`**. What happens when the key is the array index? When items move, the indices don't — so position 0 keeps the same DOM node even though it now holds a different item.
